page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, offering a stable resource density profile for workloads that require predictable compute and memory performance.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this general-purpose instance is designed for balanced workloads. Suitable applications include enterprise application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized databases that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
